fields.help_en: The account ID. This parameter is required to create an account
fields.name: account_uid

fields.help_en: The name of the baseline item
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip the baseline item. Valid values:

false: The baseline item is not skipped.
true: The baseline item is skipped
fields.help_zh:
是否跳过基线项。取值：

false：不跳过。
true：跳过
fields.name: skip

fields.help_en: The version of the baseline item
fields.name: version

parameters.help_en: The array of baseline item configurations. If this parameter is specified, the baseline item configurations are merged with the specified account baseline. For identical baseline items, the configurations in this parameter take precedence. Leave this parameter empty, specify the account baseline by using the BaselineId parameter, and apply the configurations to the account by using the existing baseline
parameters.help_zh:
基线项配置数组。

如果传递了该参数，那么基线项的配置将和指定账号基线进行合并。相同的基线项将以该参数的配置为准。建议您将该参数置空，通过`BaselineId`参数指定账号基线，通过现有基线将配置应用到账号上
parameters.name: baseline_items

parameters.help_en: The baseline ID. If this parameter is left empty, the system default baseline is used
parameters.help_zh:
基线ID。

置空则默认使用系统默认基线
parameters.name: baseline_id
